assignments.title: PREP 2
assignments.description:
Trigonometry is not something to leave in maths. You want to be able to apply it comfortably to your physics whenever vectors are involved. Velocities, Forces, etc. it is a particularly useful skill in the mechanics modules, i.e. statics, kinematics and dynamics.
All: Join this group in Isaac Science and answer the uncertainties questions there. https://isaacscience.org/account?authToken=BGMJ83
Extension Challenge: The unflinching Aviator flies from West Island to East Island in a straight line making a track across the ground from west to east. There is a steady and uniform wind with speed Vw directed with compass bearing of 30*. At the top speed of the plane, the aviator makes a speed over the ground of (3Vw/)2. The Journey takes 1 hour. If the wind speed is unchanged, what is the minimum time it takes the aviator to make the return journey? If he relies on dead reckoning what compass bearing should he fly at?
